essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer four (4) questions in this section. Write your answers clearly and show all necessary workings.

questions.question:
(a) State two examples each of physical properties and chemical properties. (4 marks)
(b) State three importance of Chemistry. (3 marks)
(c) State five branches of Chemistry. (3 marks)

(a) Briefly differentiate between the three states of matter. (6 marks)
(b) An organic compound was found on analysis to contain carbon, hydrogen and chlorine. Carbon constituted 45.86%, hydrogen 8.92% and chlorine 45.22%.
Calculate:
(i) The empirical formula of the compound. (2 marks)
(ii) The molecular formula of the compound if its relative molecular mass is 78.5. (2 marks)
[C = 12, H = 1, Cl = 35.5]

(a) State four effects of chemical industries. (4 marks)
(b) State the steps involved in the scientific method. (3 marks)
(c) Define the following terms:
(i) Mixture (1 mark)
(ii) Compound (1 mark)
(iii) Element (1 mark)
List the first twenty elements of the periodic table with their symbols. (10 marks)
Complete the table shown in the diagram below by filling in the missing mass numbers, proton numbers, electron numbers and neutron numbers. (4 marks)

(a) State the processes labelled i, ii, iii and iv in the diagram showing the changes between solid, liquid and gas.
(b) State three differences between physical changes and chemical changes. (2 marks)

(a) Calculate the relative atomic mass of sulphur having isotopes of masses 32, 33, 34 and 36 with abundances of 95.02%, 0.75%, 4.21% and 0.02% respectively. (3 marks)
(b) Calculate the Relative Molecular Mass (RMM) of C₃H₇N. (4 marks)
[C = 12, H = 1, N = 14]
